meta.description: Deviations from spec and unresolved ambiguities. Rules define what SHOULD be; this file tracks what ISN'T yet.

gaps.title: Hook Script Deployment
gaps.description: Current implementation uses direct cp/Copy-Item for hook scripts. Missing: backup_file before overwrite, deploy_managed_file interactive review, adopt/skip/merge options. User customizations are silently lost.
gaps.plannedFix: Upgrade to deploy_managed_file (same as markdown type). Adopt target: shared/hooks/<filename> in aitools repo.

gaps.title: JSON Config Backup (bash)
gaps.description: Bash versions do NOT call backup_file before settings.json merge. PowerShell versions DO call Backup-File. Platform parity gap.
gaps.plannedFix: Add backup_file call in bash before Node.js merge.

gaps.title: JSON Config Interactive Review
gaps.description: All JSON config merges are silent. Clobber detection blocks on field loss, but there is no 'here's what will change, proceed?' prompt.
gaps.plannedFix: Add field-level review menu showing changed managed fields with old → new values.

gaps.title: MCP Disable Scope (Cursor CLI)
gaps.description: agent mcp disable is project-scoped, not user-scoped. Setup runs it from the aitools repo directory only. Other projects see vercel/webflow as enabled, causing authentication errors on launch.
gaps.plannedFix: Stop deploying vercel/webflow to user-level mcp.json. Add per-project only via aitools --addmcp.

gaps.title: Backup Proliferation
gaps.description: backup_dir copies the entire directory including individual .bak.* files. Each backup contains older backups, causing cascading growth.
gaps.plannedFix: Exclude *.bak.* patterns from directory backup copies.

gaps.title: README 22 versions behind
gaps.description: README.md last updated at v0.33. Missing: logging locations, sessions feature, troubleshooting, env vars (AITOOLS_FORCE/DRY_RUN/RUN_ID), MCP status, config.json format, check scripts.
gaps.plannedFix: Full README rewrite covering current CLI, features, and troubleshooting.

gaps.title: AITOOLS_FORCE/DRY_RUN/RUN_ID env vars undocumented
gaps.description: Entry points set AITOOLS_FORCE, AITOOLS_DRY_RUN, AITOOLS_RUN_ID, AITOOLS_SUPPRESS_SUMMARY_DISPLAY env vars. Used by child scripts. Not documented in README, CLAUDE.md, or any reference file. Only discoverable by reading source.
gaps.plannedFix: Document in CLI reference and /aitools skill.

gaps.title: Sessions feature requires userRepoPath with no error
gaps.description: aitools sessions subcommands silently fail or produce confusing output if userRepoPath is not configured in ~/.aitools/config.json. No clear error directing user to run 'aitools user init'.
gaps.plannedFix: Add explicit check and error message when userRepoPath missing.

gaps.title: Logging override pattern fragile
gaps.description: Entry points redefine log/log_ok/log_error/log_warn after sourcing aitools-lib. If lib adds a new logging function, overrides miss it. No validation that overrides cover all levels. Design intent unclear: is this intentional specialization or tech debt?
gaps.plannedFix: Clarify in /logging skill and script-standards. Consider explicit delegation pattern.

gaps.title: No CI pipeline — all verification manual
gaps.description: No GitHub Actions workflow. All verification relies on manual check script invocation. PSO says 'checklist scripts, not ad-hoc' but nothing enforces running them before commit/push. Skills and hooks may partially replace CI for AI-assisted sessions, but human commits remain unguarded.

gaps.title: CLI entry point behavior undocumented
gaps.description: Entry point dispatch (noargs vs install vs gitpull vs user init), quiet pull retry logic, network detection, flag passthrough to install scripts — all only discoverable by reading source. No reference file or skill covers this.

gaps.title: Cursor skill deployment mechanism unverified
gaps.description: setup-user-mcp deploys skills to ~/.cursor/skills/. Whether Cursor Agent CLI discovers and loads these the same way Claude Code does is unverified. May be wasting deployment or may not work at all.
gaps.plannedFix: Verify Cursor skill discovery mechanism. File as gap or remove deployment.

gaps.title: Skill priority was wrong in plan v0.54
gaps.description: v0.54 plan did not specify skill priority. User-level takes precedence over project-level in Claude Code. Plan now corrected in v0.54.1 with 'no same-name overrides' rule.

gaps.title: Subagent skill preloading mechanism
gaps.description: Subagents don't inherit skills from parent. Two mechanisms: skills: field in subagent frontmatter (designed path, only works for custom types) and SubagentStart additionalContext (workaround, works for ad-hoc Agent launches). Plan uses the hook approach since ad-hoc agents are the common case. Verify both paths work as expected.

gaps.title: setup-user-mcp scales to 2 skills, needs 29+
gaps.description: setup-user-mcp currently deploys 2 skills (chrome-devtools, a11y-debugging) with hardcoded paths. Needs to scale to 29+ user-level skills with dynamic discovery from shared/skills/.
gaps.plannedFix: Refactor to iterate shared/skills/*/ directories. Add pre-built cache generation step.

gaps.title: Meta-skill for ambiguity detection
gaps.description: Surfacing duty is in gap-governance rule (always loaded). /audit provides deep review. Open question: should there be a user-level meta-skill teaching Claude HOW to identify ambiguities in documentation? Distinct from /audit (project-specific) — this would be a universal documentation analysis skill.

gaps.title: Bridge pattern reference broken
gaps.description: script-standards.md references 'See script-standards-detail.md Bridge pattern' but that section heading doesn't exist in the detail file. Cross-reference points to missing content.
gaps.plannedFix: Add Bridge pattern section to script-standards-detail.md or fix the reference.

gaps.title: Claimed skills discoverable before deployment infrastructure exists
gaps.description: Session created 4 user-level skills in shared/skills/ and claimed they would show up after restart. They won't — shared/skills/ is source, not deployment. Skills are invisible until deployed to ~/.claude/skills/ by setup-user-mcp. Barrier analysis: dependency map hook would have injected a reminder but wouldn't have definitively prevented the wrong suggestion (information problem vs reasoning problem). Root cause: knew about gap #15 but didn't connect it to the current suggestion.
gaps.plannedFix: Fix gap #15 (setup-user-mcp dynamic discovery). Decision #20 documents the policy: no hacks, fix deployment properly.

gaps.title: path-targeted-hooks-analysis.md placement not reviewed
gaps.description: Created reference/path-targeted-hooks-analysis.md without presenting for review (source-of-truth review gate violation). Also not added to sources-of-truth.md protected files table. The file may belong in reference/, plans/, or as a section within the governance plan — placement decision was not made explicitly.
gaps.plannedFix: Review file placement with user. Add to sources-of-truth.md if it stays in reference/. Consider whether it should be a section in the plan instead of a standalone file.
